extracted.name: Apple & rhubarb cooler
extracted.description: Enjoy our sophisticated apple & rhubarb cooler. Made with ginger syrup and served with a rosemary garnish, it's a good alcohol-free party option
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp of the syrup from a jar of stem ginger
instruction_lines: Fill a tumbler with ice, then pour in the apple juice, cider vinegar, stem ginger syrup and stir. Slowly top up with the sparkling rhubarb soda.
Stir again with a sprig of rosemary and leave it in the drink as the garnish.
